source: Crée un mode Battle Royale en mode Zéro Construction entièrement inspiré de Fortnite pour 100 joueurs (si c'est possible) : les joueurs commencent sur une île de départ inspirée de Fortnite avec un compte à rebours, puis montent dans un bus (lui aussi inspiré de Fortnite) qui les emmène sur une grande map inspirée de la map actuelle de Fortnite, entourée d'eau et remplie de bâtiments. Ajoute des coffres d'armes, des boîtes de munitions, une tempête (la zone) avec un minuteur, ainsi qu'un compteur affichant le nombre de joueurs restants.

image_prompt.text: Dense clusters of enterable buildings across the island - houses, shops and landmark structures entered from outside
A separate starting island where players gather before the match, with the bus waiting
A large passenger bus, treated as a flying transport, that carries players from the starting island out over the map
Open water surrounding the whole island on every side

layout_placement.text: A storm boundary that contracts over the match, compressing survivors toward a shifting centre
Weapon chests and ammunition boxes distributed through the buildings and open ground so players arm themselves from the world
Drop points along the bus route where players leave the bus and land on the island

notes: Zero-build was stated, which removes player construction but changes nothing about the layout - noted so a later step does not add build resources.

The starting island, the bus ride and the main island do not co-exist on one surface. Shooter has no multi-zone shape, so the staging island is carried as free text here; a P4 route is probably what it really needs.
One hundred players is the stated target and drives the map's extent more than anything else in the prompt.

open_questions.ask: A hundred-player island is a very large build - should the whole island be one map, or should the starting island and the main island be generated separately?
How closely should the buildings echo the reference game's look, given that assets cannot be copied?

theme: Stylised modern - colourful contemporary buildings and landmarks, bright and readable rather than realistic

coverage_missing.ask: How large should the island be for 100 players?
Last player standing, or is there a squad mode?
Should the starting island be a separate map or a corner of the main one?

answers.ask: A hundred-player island is a very large build - should the whole island be one map, or should the starting island and the main island be generated separately?
answers.answer: Générez l'île de départ séparément de l'île principale afin de garder le mode lisible et performant ; le bus transporte ensuite les joueurs vers la grande map de match.

answers.ask: How closely should the buildings echo the reference game's look, given that assets cannot be copied?
answers.answer: Utilisez un style cartoon coloré de battle royale, avec des bâtiments originaux et variés inspirés de l'ambiance générale, sans copier les assets ni les lieux exacts de Fortnite.
